fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Sophos Central API credential client ID (Global Settings → API Credentials Management).

fields.label: Client secret
fields.description: Sophos Central API credential client secret.

fields.label: Data-region API host
fields.description: Tenant data-region host, no scheme (e.g. api-us01.central.sophos.com). Get it from GET https://api.central.sophos.com/whoami/v1 (apiHosts.dataRegion). See SKILL.md.

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: Tenant UUID from whoami (id). Sent as the X-Tenant-ID header on every call; stored securely.
